description: Kiro house-style acceptance criteria (all-caps keywords, literal THE SYSTEM, no leading comma). Clean under kiro; the same lines fail under strict on casing (ES-D-007, EARS-E014) and, where a leading clause is present, the missing leading comma (ES-D-001, EARS-E015). Each line carries a per-profile expectation so one file drives both sides. The kiro profile also sets EARS-W011 and EARS-W014 to off so free-form domain vocabulary stays clean when a catalog is supplied; without a catalog neither warning fires, confirmed against lintEars on the canonical-cased equivalent of every line.
currentBehavior: The parser does not yet consume the dialect block (packages/core/src/shell-parser.ts and lint.ts ignore Options.dialect). Running lintEars on the raw all-caps, no-comma lines yields EARS-E008 (missing system name) for the leading-clause forms and parses the ubiquitous form as valid; it does not yet emit EARS-E014 or EARS-E015. Once C4b wires keywordCase='strict' to emit EARS-E014 and commaAfterLeadingClause='required' to emit EARS-E015, the strict column below holds and kiro (case-insensitive, THE SYSTEM literal, optional comma) stays clean.

lines.text: WHEN a user submits valid credentials THE SYSTEM SHALL establish an authenticated session.
WHEN a user submits an unrecognized email THE SYSTEM SHALL display a sign-in error that does not reveal which field was wrong.
IF five consecutive sign-in attempts fail THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL lock the account for fifteen minutes.
WHILE a background sync is in progress THE SYSTEM SHALL disable the manual save control.
WHERE offline mode is enabled THE SYSTEM SHALL queue outbound changes on the local device.
THE SYSTEM SHALL persist the working draft every thirty seconds.
WHEN a sync request returns a network error THE SYSTEM SHALL show a retry banner above the editor.
IF the retry banner is dismissed THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL schedule a silent retry after two minutes.
WHEN the access token expires THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect the author to the sign-in page.
